spanish: Como jornalero, como residente, será contigo; hasta año del yovel servirá contigo.

findings.issue: yovel leaves the common noun הַיֹּבֵל (H3104) untranslated; common nouns stay Spanish
jornalero narrows the substantival hired adjective to a day-wage laborer
residente keeps the dweller sense and leaves the sojourner/non-native sense of תּוֹשָׁב open or thin
hasta año does not mark the definiteness of the construct chain שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל

notes: 3ms qal verbs, both כְּ phrases, and both 2fs עִמָּךְ as contigo match the tokens.
